# Repomap Task Lens v0 Codex bundle

Give Codex:

- the current repomap checkout;
- this directory;
- the existing Fuego benchmark outputs and supervisor-curated corpus packages.

Start with `CODEX_TASK_LENS_V0_PROMPT.md`.

The development set may use historical gold. The holdout set may not use gold
until all holdout Task Packs are sealed.

This task builds and evaluates a bounded task-conditioned investigation overlay.
It does not replace the Repository Guide.
